setting.description: The Data folder of a Korean MapleStory2 client, the one whose item data is in bundles (Xml.m2d holds itemdata/*.xml). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_CLIENT_DATA. Leave it empty when you have no such client.

The Data folder of a global (North America / Europe) MapleStory2 client, the one with one file per item (Xml.m2d holds item/...). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_GMS_CLIENT_DATA. Leave it empty when you have no such client.
The data folder of your local server (the one holding its Xml.m2d). It is only read. Empty = the environment variable MS2_SERVER_DATA.

Folder of mod folders (each with a mod.xml). Save mod writes here; Plan and Apply use the mods that are checked in the view's list, in its order (kept in modkit-mods.xml in this folder). Empty = the environment variable MS2_MODS.

Where Apply writes patched copies of the archives (client/ and server/ under it): the server's always, the client's when "Apply to" is the workspace. Empty = the environment variable MS2_MOD_WORKSPACE.

The folder of a COPY of your client that holds Data. With "Apply to: game folder", Apply writes the changed client tables there as plain files (Data/Xml/...), which the game reads before its archives; Revert removes exactly those files. Empty = the environment variable MS2_GAME_DIR.

Optional. After a successful Apply, every server archive the mods changed (the .m2d and its .m2h) is copied from the workspace into this folder, for example the data folder a server reads. The files it replaces are kept and put back by Revert. Plan names the folder before anything is written. Empty = the environment variable MS2_SERVER_TARGET; both empty = no copy.

Optional. A command line that is run after a successful Apply or Revert, meant for a server's own import step. Plan shows the command before it runs; its output and exit code appear in the view's output box. {target} and {workspace} in the line stand for the two folders. Empty = the environment variable MS2_AFTER_APPLY; both empty = nothing is run.

action.label: Items
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 Items view: one item across its files, with clone to a new id

action.label: NPCs
action.tooltip: Shows the MS2 NPCs view: one npc across its files and targets, with clone to a new id

action.label: Plan
action.tooltip: Shows what the enabled mods of the mods folder (and the pending edits) would change, with conflicts and warnings; writes nothing

action.label: Apply
action.tooltip: Saves the mod being edited and writes what the enabled mods change: loose files into the game folder, or patched copies of the archives into the workspace folder

action.label: Revert
action.tooltip: Removes what Apply wrote: the loose files in the game folder and the patched copies in the workspace folder
